newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares gain momentum, Hansapank leads.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares gain momentum, Hansapank leads.

text.p: The Estonian stock market was busy and prices rose on Thursday, with leading bank Hansapank the most traded.
Official list trade totalled 26.1 million kroons while the index rose 1.48 percent to 162.73.
"The buying pressure was pretty strong on the market. Investors, especially the funds, are forming new portfolios," said one dealer, adding that there was no corporate news.
Market leader Hansapank was the most traded share with a volume of 8.9 million kroons as it fell to 161.20 kroons from 161.75 at the end of the last session.

Trade in the second biggest bank Estonian Savings bank totalled 4.7 million kroons and the share closed 5.85 kroons higher at 75. Union bank rose to 32.40 kroons from 29 in turnover of 2.6 million kroons.
Tallinn Pharmaceutical plant had volume of 3.4 million kroons to close at 105.20 kroons against 105.75.

The over-the-counter market was led by Tallinna Kaubamaja department store which turned over 3 million kroons and edged slightly lower to 75.15 kroons versus 75.75. The total volume of the free market was 6.7 million kroons.
